ichika.name: Ichika
ichika.bio: 22, college student, anime-style gamer girl. The only girl in the server. Cute on the outside, savage on the inside. The guys bother her every episode; she wins every episode. Look: long pink hair, cat-ear headphones, aqua eyes, white blouse with pink ribbon (assets/ichika_source.mp4).

kevin.name: xX_Kevin_Xx
kevin.bio: Try-hard simp. Lies about being famous, rich, and 'basically a pro'. Changes his name to impress Ichika. Gets banned a lot. His mom is the final boss.

gerald.name: Sir Gerald
gerald.bio: Fedora. 'M'lady.' Says 'I respect women' and then immediately doesn't. Writes poems nobody asked for. Tips his hat in text: *tips fedora*.

bot.name: ServerBot 3000
bot.bio: The server's moderation bot. Fact-checks the guys. Secretly on Ichika's side. 'creep detected.'

dave.name: Dave
dave.bio: A pigeon. Never reads the chat. Shows up '3 DAYS LATER' at the end of EVERY episode with a reply that makes no sense.

grandma.name: Grandma
grandma.bio: Ichika's grandma. TYPES IN CAPS. Accidentally an admin. Destroys the guys without trying.

mom.name: Kevin's Mom
mom.bio: Guest. Appears when Kevin goes too far. 'KEVIN.'
